gloss: to go on a business trip

definitions.gloss: to go on a business trip; to travel for work
definitions.explanation: To travel to a place away from one's usual workplace for business purposes. Often involves overnight stays and expense reports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出張|しゅっちょう}する。
examples.english: I'm going on a business trip to Osaka next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧ほど⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出張|しゅっちょう}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My father goes on overseas business trips about twice a month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張先|しゅっちょうさき}→出張先：27265_shucchousaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}しなければ→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I had to prepare materials at the hotel where I was staying on my business trip.

notes:
Refers specifically to work-related travel, not personal trips. The noun form ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧ is frequently used on its own without ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, especially in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出張先|しゅっちょうさき}→出張先：27265_shucchousaki⟧: business trip destination
- ⟦{出張費|しゅっちょうひ}→出張費：25964_shucchouhi⟧: business trip expenses
- {出張報告|しゅっちょうほうこく}: business trip report
- ⟦{海外出張|かいがいしゅっちょう}→海外出張：24173_kaigaishucchou⟧: overseas business trip
- {日帰り出張|ひがえりしゅっちょう}: day trip for business

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧: travel — general term for trips, not work-specific
- ⟦{赴任|ふにん}→赴任：10601_funin⟧: taking up a new post — implies relocation, not a temporary trip
